cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a desert oasis at golden hour — holds a water bottle at chest height; a harbour quay of a port town with tall sailing ships — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a Three Kingdoms festival street — lying on her side; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; a festival street of lanterns — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a small shop — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — sitting on the ground; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — standing; a city park with benches — standing; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — perched on a ledge or edge; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — holds a water bottle at chest height; the grand staircase of an old castle — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a glass greenhouse full of plants with a wooden potting bench — holds her keepsake up beside her face
